# The Huffman codebooks of AAC: ISO/IEC 14496-3 Annex 4.A, Tables 4.A.1
# (scalefactors, book 0) to 4.A.12 (spectrum books 1 to 11), as the
# standard prints them: book, codeword index, length, codeword in hex.
#
# Extracted from the text of two editions of the standard (2001 and 2009),
# which agree line for line, and checked on extraction: every book has the
# number of entries Table 4.151 implies, indices 0..n-1, no codeword is a
# prefix of another, and the Kraft sum of each book is exactly one.
# tools/aac_dec_model.py builds the decoder's tree ROM from this file, and
# tests/ip_aac_dec.rs decodes every codeword here through that ROM.
